_readme: Candidate Linux x86_64 profile for dependency and capability checks only. The full Linux workflow is not validated/supported. Copy locally to a device profile, replace every path, and retain the warning. Never store machine.json in the README/release folder. Device-workspace mode uses the parent folder of the selected README and creates devices/<device-instance>/episodes/<code>; if that location is unavailable, tools use isolated device-local roots without making folder creation a workflow gate.
notes: Use dependencies/environment-linux-x86_64.yml and the x86_64 direct Python lock for environment preparation.
Decode-Orc/PowerShell/VapourSynth plugin integration and the complete Linux delivery/QC workflow remain unvalidated. Do not use this profile as a support claim.
